title: Battle of Wimpfen
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Wimpfen", at revision 1370276930, opens: "The Battle of Wimpfen took place during the Palatinate campaign period of the Thirty Years' War on 6 May 1622 near Wimpfen." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q661764, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1622 battle of the thirty years war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
